title: ⑱ 目标有效带宽与物理页扫描

capability.scope: real per-page NandCore execution plus finite-buffer pipelined ResourceTimeline link transfers; transport microbenchmark only

rows.measurement_scope: primary rate is total completed logical read bytes divided by time from arrival zero to final actual link completion, including startup, media latency, finite buffer backpressure and link latency. Link-stream rate starts at first link transmission and is a separate denominator.
rows.hardware_scope: Hypothetical 2048 physical array units and 2048 effective slots, explicit 12000 GB/s per internal channel, configured host port and separate transport link. This is sufficient-parallelism sensitivity, not a claim of realizable HBF geometry, pins or area.
rows.buffer_scope: Finite transport FIFO slots gate requests until link completion. The FIFO is capacity/backpressure state only; no additional DRAM read/write bandwidth is modeled.
rows.physical_page_scope: page_bytes controls actual NAND mapping, full-page read latency and read bytes; chunk_bytes is independently the link transport unit. 1.5 MiB physical pages are an attachment-requested hypothetical sensitivity, not vendor NAND specifications.

coverage.prior_physical_page_scan: 05 already contains hypothetical 1.5 MiB physical NAND pages; this group adds an independently fixed logical payload and transport chunk comparison.

limitations: Targets use decimal GB/s: 400/1600/3000 GB/s = 0.4/1.6/3.0 TB/s. A configured port value alone is not observed throughput.
This generously parallel synthetic inventory is not a feasibility, cost, area, packaging or real-silicon assertion.
All points execute 384 MiB of sequential reads in 1.5 MiB transport chunks with at most 64 finite FIFO slots. There is no GPU/token serving denominator.
Read-latency and physical-page scans retain the same authored geometry and port/link budget, so their actual parallelism bottlenecks remain visible.
1.5 MiB physical pages are explicitly hypothetical; this variable is separate from the unchanged 1.5 MiB transport chunk.
The link models serialized byte transfer and fixed propagation latency, without packet framing, retries, coherence or protocol calibration.
Finite FIFO backpressure is modeled; additional staging-memory service is outside this transport benchmark.
